Christopher "dexter" Nong (born August 15, 1994) is an Australian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player. Prior to joining his former team MOUZ in February 2021, dexter most famously played as part of the Grayhound-Renegades Oceanian core.
